parameters.query: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_runs (run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, agent TEXT NOT NULL, event_id TEXT, event_type TEXT, subject TEXT, started TIMESTAMPTZ, finished TIMESTAMPTZ, exit_reason TEXT, outcome TEXT, summary TEXT, outputs JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS agent_runs_created_idx ON agent_runs (created_at DESC); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_dedupe (dedupe_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, agent TEXT NOT NULL, subject TEXT, last_event_id TEXT, first_launched TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), last_launched TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), cooldown_until TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, launches INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1);

WITH s AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS p), claim AS ( INSERT INTO agent_dedupe AS d (dedupe_key, agent, subject, last_event_id, last_launched, cooldown_until) SELECT p->'event'->>'dedupe_key', p->>'agent', p->'event'->>'subject', p->'event'->>'id', now(), now() + make_interval(hours => GREATEST(COALESCE((p->>'cooldown_hours')::int, 6), 1)) FROM s WHERE COALESCE(p->'event'->>'dedupe_key', '') <> '' ON CONFLICT (dedupe_key) DO UPDATE SET last_launched = now(), cooldown_until = EXCLUDED.cooldown_until, last_event_id = EXCLUDED.last_event_id, subject = EXCLUDED.subject, launches = d.launches + 1 WHERE d.cooldown_until <= now() RETURNING d.dedupe_key) SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM claim) AS claimed;

parameters.query: INSERT INTO agent_runs (run_id, agent, event_id, event_type, subject, started, finished, exit_reason, outcome, summary, outputs) SELECT p->>'run_id', p->>'agent', p->>'event_id', p->>'event_type', p->>'subject', (p->>'started')::timestamptz, (p->>'finished')::timestamptz, p->>'exit_reason', p->>'outcome', p->>'summary', COALESCE(p->'outputs', '[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT $1::jsonb AS p) AS s ON CONFLICT (run_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING run_id, agent, outcome, exit_reason, summary, outputs;

WITH s AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS p), prior AS (SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM agent_runs r, s WHERE r.exit_reason = s.p->>'exit_reason' AND r.event_type IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.p->>'event_type' AND r.created_at > now() - interval '6 hours'), ins AS (INSERT INTO agent_runs (run_id, agent, event_id, event_type, subject, started, finished, exit_reason, outcome, summary, outputs) SELECT p->>'run_id', p->>'agent', p->>'event_id', p->>'event_type', p->>'subject', (p->>'started')::timestamptz, (p->>'finished')::timestamptz, p->>'exit_reason', p->>'outcome', p->>'summary', COALESCE(p->'outputs', '[]'::jsonb) FROM s ON CONFLICT (run_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING run_id, agent, outcome, exit_reason, summary, subject) SELECT ins.run_id, ins.agent, ins.outcome, ins.exit_reason, ins.summary, ins.subject, prior.n AS prior_same FROM ins CROSS JOIN prior;
